action.message:
Implemented the feature contract in django/contrib/admin/options.py.

Change: In ModelAdmin.changelist_view, the POSTed list_editable bulk-edit loop (save_form/save_model/save_related/log_change) is now wrapped in `with transaction.atomic(using=router.db_for_write(self.model)):`. This ensures all edits made through the changelist are committed atomically and rolled back on error, preventing unexpected partial states. `transaction` and `router` were already imported.

Verification: scoped_tests public regression selection (admin_changelist) passed — 74 tests, 0 failures.
